Birth.BornCity: A village in the lands of the Arverni

Naked: Almost always barefoot, finding sandals to be clumsy and loud.
Story: The five sisters are survivors of a Roman massacre in their Gallic village. Having lost their family and people, they fled into the forests. They have sworn a vow of celibacy, promising not to rest or know peace until Julius Caesar, the man responsible for their people's suffering, is dead. They use their unique combat skills to survive and fight back against the Roman invaders.

BodyMarks.Name: Freckles
BodyMarks.Description: A prominent spray of freckles across the bridge of her nose.

Details.Name: Hair
Descriptions: Bright, carrot-orange hair, cut short and messy for practicality.
Mischievous, ever-watchful eyes.

Details.Name: Body
Descriptions: Compact, wiry, and athletic build.
Fair skin covered in freckles.

Details.Name: Color
Descriptions: A cascade of fiery, russet red, with sun-bleached streaks from constant exposure to the elements.

Details.Name: Style and Length
Descriptions: Thick, wavy, and long enough to reach the middle of her back, usually restrained in a loose, functional braid intertwined with leather cords.

Details.Name: Texture
Descriptions: Coarse and wild, often carrying the scent of pine and damp earth, with small twigs or leaves occasionally caught in its strands.

Details.Name: Color
Descriptions: A vibrant moss green, flecked with shards of gold that seem to catch the light, especially when she is angry or focused.

Details.Name: Shape
Descriptions: Wide and almond-shaped, slightly upturned at the corners, giving her a perpetually alert, almost predatory appearance.

Details.Name: Shape
Descriptions: A straight, slender bridge that slopes to a subtly upturned, inquisitive tip.

Details.Name: Skin
Descriptions: A faint constellation of freckles is scattered across the bridge, a youthful feature contrasting with her hardened expression.

Details.Name: Shape and Function
Descriptions: Delicate in shape but seemingly sharp, they are sensitive to the slightest sound of the forest, from a snapping twig to a distant bird call.

Details.Name: Adornment
Descriptions: The lobes are unpierced, rejecting adornment in favor of pure practicality.

Details.Name: Lips
Descriptions: Neither full nor thin, her lips are expressive and often pressed into a firm line of concentration or pulled into a rare, quicksilver smirk.

Details.Name: Color and Condition
Descriptions: Pale rose in color, frequently chapped by the wind and cold.

Details.Name: Shape
Descriptions: Long and graceful, yet corded with taught sinew that becomes prominent when she turns her head, a testament to her constant vigilance.

Details.Name: Marking
Descriptions: A thin, silvery scar curves just below her left ear, a permanent reminder of a narrowly dodged attack.

Details.Name: Build
Descriptions: Broad for her slender frame but not bulky, defined by the lean, powerful muscles developed from archery and climbing.

Details.Name: Skin
Descriptions: Her skin here is tanned and carries a map of fine, white scratches from pushing through thorny underbrush.

Details.Name: Musculature
Descriptions: Wiry and toned, her biceps and forearms show clear definition from drawing a bowstring and wielding a blade, built for speed over brute force.

Details.Name: Tattoos
Descriptions: Faded blue woad tattoos of Celtic knots and spirals wrap around her forearms, symbols of her lost tribe.

Details.Name: Shape
Descriptions: Long, nimble fingers capable of tying intricate knots, setting traps, or gripping a sword hilt with unyielding strength.

Details.Name: Condition
Descriptions: The palms and knuckles are heavily calloused, and her skin is stained with dirt, herbs, and berry juice.

Details.Name: Length
Descriptions: Kept trimmed short out of necessity, to avoid splitting or snagging during a fight.

Details.Name: Condition
Descriptions: Frequently chipped and broken, with a permanent crescent of forest soil lodged underneath them.

Details.Name: Structure
Descriptions: A strong, defined set of collarbones frames her neck, sitting above a solid rib cage that is visible due to her lean physique.

Details.Name: Function
Descriptions: Her breathing is deep and even, showcasing a formidable stamina built from a life on the run.

Details.Name: Musculature
Descriptions: Flat and hard as a whetstone, with subtle but clear definition of her core muscles, honed by agility and combat training.

Details.Name: Skin
Descriptions: The skin is taut and responsive to her every movement.

Details.Name: Shape
Descriptions: Athletic and narrow, built for explosive speed rather than soft curves. Her hip bones are sharp and prominent.

Details.Name: Stance
Descriptions: A leather belt carrying pouches and her dagger is slung low, resting naturally on the sharp angle of her hips.

Details.Name: Musculature
Descriptions: Long, sinewy, and powerful, with pronounced calf and thigh muscles developed for running, leaping, and maintaining a low, steady stance in combat.

Details.Name: Markings
Descriptions: Her skin is a tapestry of nicks, bruises, and faded scars from navigating the treacherous forest terrain.

Details.Name: Shape
Descriptions: Broad with high arches, they are tough and weathered, more like tools than appendages.

Details.Name: Condition
Descriptions: The soles are thick and heavily calloused from traveling long distances in simple leather wraps or completely barefoot.

Details.Name: Appearance
Descriptions: Covered by a neat, dense triangle of pubic hair the same fiery red as on her head.

Details.Name: Significance
Descriptions: Wholly private and untouched, a physical representation of her vow of celibacy and singular focus on revenge.

Details.Name: Size and Shape
Descriptions: Small, firm, and athletic, suited to a life of agility and movement. They are often tightly bound in linen to keep them secure during fights.

Details.Name: Appearance
Descriptions: The nipples are a shade of dusty rose, and the pale skin around them is taut and unblemished.

Talents: Can move through dense forest without making a sound.

Description: A sling and a pouch of lead bullets
A small pouch with trail markers like carved stones

Notes: The eyes and ears of the sisters, she ranges ahead to find safe paths and warn of danger.
